single_record_rule: Ready-to-use and construction-material views are projections of one versioned reusable template record. They are not independently authoritative copies.

projection_contracts.purpose: Give an authorized GM enough bounded material to use the template quickly without hiding requirements, warnings, uncertainty or provenance.
must_include: authorized bounded structure needed for use
source/provenance references permitted for the initiating subject
may_suppress: expert-only construction metadata not needed for rapid use
protected source details the initiating subject is not authorized/entitled to view
must_not_do: present unresolved required material as resolved
hide a blocking compatibility problem to make the template look ready
expose hidden or restricted source material through summaries, counts, tags or warnings

projection_contracts.purpose: Expose authorized replaceable parts, slots, dependencies, transformations and lineage so a GM can remix the same reusable template safely.
must_include: current fill state including unresolved/intentionally-open states
must_not_do: expose a source-restricted slot value merely because the slot exists
convert a replaceable part into a permission to alter external canon
offer forbidden auto-fill for a slot whose authority behavior forbids it
erase prior lineage when replacing or transforming a slot

authority_labels.approved_library_record: Approved for reusable GCL library use; not runtime or canon authority.
authority_labels.proposal_requires_owning_domain_acceptan: A derived or customized result remains a proposal until the owning domain accepts it.
authority_labels.external_canon_reference: Canonical status is asserted only by referenced external owning-domain evidence; GCL does not grant it.
authority_labels.synthetic_fixture: Validation-only material; never production library or canon content.

authorization_and_entitlement.rule: Projection happens after applicable authorization, visibility and entitlement evaluation. GCL metadata cannot be used to infer protected existence, counts, source details or hidden relationships.
safe_behaviors: preserve a safe unresolved dependency marker when appropriate
retain authorized historical provenance without widening current access
unsafe_behaviors: explain a restriction using protected names or IDs
let AI retrieval see a broader projection than the initiating subject

projection_consistency.checksum_relationship: A projection receipt references the source template digest/version plus the projection policy version; the projection does not become a new source template unless explicitly saved as a derived record with new stable identity and lineage.

save_as_derived_record.rule: When a GM intentionally saves a remix/customization as a reusable or local derived object, create a new stable identity/version appropriate to the owning scope and preserve lineage to the source GCL template.

ai_projection_boundary.allowed_input: Only the initiating subject's authorization-filtered projection plus separately authorized governed sources.
